station_name: GUNNISON RIVER NEAR GRAND JUNCTION, COLO.
notes: Rotated page. 19 sample rows (5+5+5+4), each a composite over a printed span of days (Oct. 1-13, 1965 ... May 13-23). 14 columns hold values in every row: mean discharge, sodium, bicarbonate, carbonate, sulfate, chloride, dissolved solids (ppm, tons per acre-foot, tons per day), hardness (calcium-magnesium, noncarbonate), sodium adsorption ratio, specific conductance, pH; 14 x 19 = 266. Silica, iron, calcium, magnesium, potassium, fluoride, nitrate, boron columns are empty. All 14 columns counted as measurements; the rules do not say whether computed columns (tons per acre-foot, tons per day, hardness, sodium adsorption ratio = 76 values) are measurements or summaries. Title says water year October 1965 to September 1966 but the rows on this page end in May; dates are the first and last printed sample dates, year 1966 for May taken from the 'Jan. 1-31, 1966' row. Composite periods called discrete; rules do not cover composites. Location text also gives: at gaging station at bridge on State Highway 141, 0.4 mile downstream from Whitewater Creek, 0.5 mile south of Whitewater, and 8 miles southeast of Grand Junction. '(Irrigation network station)' printed under the name.
